'''Duranium''' was a metallic alloy with high tensile strength.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> It was much stronger than either [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] or [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]]. It was extremely durable, light, and was capable of withstanding a glancing blow from a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. It also had a very high melting point, making it difficult to shape. 

It was often used to make [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cells and cages.<ref name="TCSWE" />
